title: delaunay2D
body:
## delaunay2D

Builds a 2-D Delaunay triangulation of the input points (any point set, e.g. a point cloud or the points of a mesh; input cells are ignored) and outputs polydata triangles. Triangulation is done in the x-y plane: z is ignored for connectivity but kept on the points, so it suits height fields and nearly planar sets aligned with x-y. With alpha 0 (Schemaxis default) every triangle of the convex hull is kept; a positive alpha keeps only triangles whose circumcircle radius is at most alpha, carving concave outlines and gaps. Use pvDelaunay2D for a best-fitting plane, and delaunay3D for tetrahedra.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Points on a plane not parallel to x-y (e.g. a vertical wall) triangulate badly or collapse; transform them first or use pvDelaunay2D with ProjectionPlaneMode Best-Fitting Plane.
- Points closer than tolerance (a fraction of the bounding-box diagonal) are discarded as duplicates.

Native constructor: `Delaunay2D`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input dataset to the Delaunay 2D filter. Accepted data: explicit-point datasets (polygonal, unstructured or structured grids) (vtkPointSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPointSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `alpha` | The value of this property controls the output of this filter. For a non-zero alpha value, only edges or triangles contained within a sphere centered at mesh vertices will be output. Otherwise, only triangles will be output. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0}` | `0` | `0` |
| `tolerance` | This property specifies a tolerance to control discarding of closely spaced points. This tolerance is specified as a fraction of the diagonal length of the bounding box of the points. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0}` | `1e-05` | `1e-05` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "delaunay2D",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input"
  }
}
```
